question: A student goes to his college from his hostel at the speed of 4 Km/h and returns at the speed of 3 Km/h. If he takes 7 h in going and coming, the distance between his college and hostel is:
solution:
**Given:**

Speed from hostel to college = 4 Km/h

Speed from college to hostel = 3 Km/h

Total time taken = 7 h

**Formula used:**

Total time = dfrac{Distance}{Speed1} + dfrac{Distance}{Speed2}</p&
